description: Write, rewrite, or line-edit prose so it reads as a professional wrote it, not a model: clear, specific, register-appropriate, and free of AI writing tells. Apply to any prose a human will read. Triggers include "make this sound human", "remove the AI tells", "de-slop this", "does this read like ChatGPT wrote it", "humanize this draft", "rewrite this professionally", or any request to draft or sharpen an email, blog post, op-ed, report, memo, or longform message.
